title: sorbus japonica
intro: Sorbus japonica, commonly known as Japanese rowan or Japanese mountain ash, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to East Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus japonica include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as fever, sore throat, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
